extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides clear, step-by-step instructions for basic powwow dance movements. She emphasizes the importance of practice and cultural context throughout the lesson.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces herself and the dance style.
The teacher breaks down the basic rhythm using hand claps.
The teacher demonstrates the basic rhythm on the ground.
The teacher applies the rhythm to footwork.
The teacher explains the front step.
The teacher explains how to practice the step while walking.
The teacher introduces a more advanced, bouncy style.
The teacher explains how to create choreography by visualizing a box.
The teacher combines the steps into a short routine.
The teacher provides closing thoughts and advice for aspiring dancers.

what_works: The teacher uses clear, simple language and breaks down complex movements into manageable parts.
The use of visual aids, such as clapping and visualizing a box, helps to make the instructions easier to understand.
what_hinders: The video is relatively short and does not provide a lot of time for practice.

quotes.text: Notice here that 1 is a tap and 2 is all your body weight.
To do just that step for one whole song is very hard.
Just ease into it and just practice, practice, practice.
It was taught to me that when I put on my regalia, I am a role model.
